thread:
Priya: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/861 updates the Python SDK snippet in the migration guide. It's marked `ready` but can't auto-merge: branch protection requires `ci/full` + `codeowners/approval`. docs/preview passed. Anyone else seen this combo?
Tom: I ran into this last week. If the `ci/full` check is treated as required but skipped for docs-only, GH still blocks. Is this PR touching only docs/ and nothing else?
Priya: yes only docs/ and a tiny example file under docs/examples/python.md. CI shows `docs/preview` green, `ci/full` absent (skipped). label-bot didn't add `docs-only` label quickly enough.
Isabel: two immediate fixes: 1) change branch protection to accept `docs/preview` instead of `ci/full` for docs repo, or 2) have a lightweight action that creates a success status named `ci/full (skipped)` when only docs changed.
label-bot: "label-bot added labels: docs, needs-review"
Priya: thanks label-bot. Adding `docs` didn't help retroactively. Auto-merge evaluated before label was added.
Tom: Another nuance: CODEOWNERS entry `/docs @docs-team` triggers a required reviewer. We have a bot that auto-approves docs PRs, but it runs after checks too. Sequence matters.
Isabel: platform/infra owns branch protection. @eng-infra can you advise whether changing required checks is okay?
eng-infra: quick reply — we prefer minimizing phantom statuses. Safer route: update branch-protection to include `docs/preview` as acceptable required check for the docs repo. We can schedule that this week.
Priya: Can we do a manual unblock? Merge-bot has a bypass token if an owner approves.
merge-bot: "merge-bot: Manual override requires 2 owners to sign off, or label `docs:manual-merge` plus one owner approval."
Tom: For speed, I'd prefer a small GitHub Action that posts a status when only docs files changed. Something like: ```name: docs-skipped-ci
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  set-status:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: detect docs-only
        run: |
          files=$(git diff --name-only origin/main...$GITHUB_SHA)
          if echo "$files" | grep -qE '^docs/'; then
            echo "docs-only"
            gh api repos/:owner/:repo/statuses/$GITHUB_SHA -f state=success -f context=ci/full
          fi
```
Isabel: that approach works but creates an ambiguous status named `ci/full` with no logs. If we do it, make the context `ci/full (skipped)` and update branch protection to accept that exact name — otherwise GH won't treat it as the required `ci/full`.
Priya: hmm GH matches exact check names for required checks, so a different context won't satisfy `ci/full`. We either need to fake `ci/full` or change branch protection.
eng-infra: preference is to change branch protection. Creating fake success statuses can be abused and confuses audit trails. We can make the change scoped to the docs repo only.
Tom: For long term, can we make the auto-merge bot consult a small config in the repo, e.g., `.github/auto-merge.yml` with: ```required: ["docs/preview"] optional: ["ci/full"] size_threshold: 200 lines``` That way docs repos are tolerant.
Priya: I like that. I'll draft a tiny RFC and a PR to add the config + a one-off action to create a `ci/full` success only if enabled by a repo admin label. That balances safety.
Isabel: operational checklist: - file RFC for auto-merge config - eng-infra to patch branch protection for docs repo this week - implement optional action behind admin toggle - update CODEOWNERS to mark docs team as non-blocking for docs-only PRs
label-bot: "label-bot added labels: docs:manual-merge"
Priya: added `docs:manual-merge` as requested. @Isabel can you approve so merge-bot can do the manual path?
Isabel: approved. Going to merge now. 
merge-bot: "merge-bot: Merged by manual-override. PR #861 -> main."
Priya: thanks all. I'll follow up with the RFC and ping eng-infra for the branch-protection change. If anyone else hits this, note whether PR came from fork vs branch; forks have different runner permissions.
Tom: noted — thanks. :rocket:
